- **F1**: Shifts photosynthetic peak to red/NIR wavelengths.; Reduces atmospheric stripping over geological timescales.; Extends stellar habitability window for complex life.

- **F18**: Broad plains dominate, limiting vertical hunting grounds.; Chemosynthetic vent ecosystems become primary nutrient hubs.; Effusive volcanism recycles crustal minerals without explosive fragmentation.
- **F19**: Drives deep-red/black phototroph pigmentation.; Limits visible-light competition.; Favors NIR-sensitive visual systems.
- **F20**: Enzymes require pressure equilibrium to maintain catalysis.; Rapid decompression causes barotrauma paralysis.; Polyunsaturated lipids prevent membrane rigidification under load.
